meta.note: The city past the play box. boxes: [x, z, w, d, h, rot, cls, g], game units, rot = rotation.y (w along local X). cls 0 = the low fabric (OpenStreetMap footprints; height from the height / levels tags, else by footprint area) of a 30 u cell within 560 u of the box edge as one mass (area-weighted height, sized to the built area); cls 1 = an OpenStreetMap building of 40 m or more (its own oriented rectangle) within 700 u of the box (Roppongi Hills, Tokyo Midtown, Akasaka, Kioicho, Shinagawa, Toyosu, Ariake, the Odaiba towers). Nothing is boxed on the water. g = ground under the box in game units from the terrarium DEM (the Yamanote plateau 25-40 m at Roppongi, Azabu and Shirokane; the low city and the reclaimed islands 0-5 m): 0 within 40 u of the play box edge and ramped in over the next 60 u so the surround meets the flat play area; lift the backdrop by g (or a share of it), or ignore it. named: name -> index into boxes (towers of 100 m and more, and other named towers). water: Tokyo Bay, the port, the Sumida, Arakawa and Meguro rivers and the canals over the fetch area (x -2000..2000, z -2000..2400) as {name, polygon, holes}; the reclaimed islands are holes of the bay polygon, so a point is wet only inside a polygon and outside its holes. islands: outline polygons of the islands that lie wholly or mostly outside the box (Odaiba / Aomi, Ariake, Shinagawa and Oi wharves, the Central Breakwater ...), x / z = a point on the island. masts: none (Tokyo Tower is in play; the Skytree is moved into play). cranes: container gantry cranes synthesised along the Oi, Aomi and Shinagawa quays (OSM maps only a handful; synthesised: true, positions approximate, rot = along the quay). horizon: far features by bearing (deg clockwise from north) and distance from the origin.

water.name: Tokyo Bay, the port, the Sumida and Arakawa rivers and the canals

islands.name: Oi Wharf
islands.note: the Oi container terminal: two kilometres of quay with gantry cranes

islands.name: Ariake
islands.note: Ariake: the Big Sight exhibition halls with their inverted pyramids, arenas, tower blocks

islands.name: Odaiba and Aomi (Landfill No. 13)
islands.note: the rest of Odaiba: Palette Town site, the Telecom Center, the Aomi container terminal on its west quay

islands.name: Toyosu and Shinonome
islands.note: the rest of Toyosu, Shinonome and Tatsumi: tower mansions and canals

islands.name: Yumenoshima and Shin-Kiba
islands.note: Yumenoshima park and the timber yards of Shin-Kiba

islands.name: Central Breakwater landfill
islands.note: the outer and inner Central Breakwater landfills, low and bare, the Tokyo Gate Bridge beyond

islands.name: Wakasu
islands.note: Wakasu: golf links and the Tokyo Gate Bridge landing

islands.name: Koto delta (Kiba, Fukagawa)
islands.note: the low city east of the Sumida between its canals

islands.name: Koto delta (Kiba, Fukagawa) (2)
islands.note: the low city east of the Sumida between its canals

islands.name: Koto delta (Kiba, Fukagawa) (3)
islands.note: the low city east of the Sumida between its canals

horizon.name: Mount Fuji
horizon.note: the snow-capped cone of Fuji on the west-south-west horizon, clearest at dawn and at dusk when it stands in silhouette against the afterglow; the level looks that way down the avenues of Shiba and Mita

horizon.name: Tanzawa Mountains (Mount Tanzawa, Mount Oyama)
horizon.note: the dark saw-toothed wall of the Tanzawa range in front of and to the left of Fuji, the pyramid of Oyama (1,252 m) at its east end

horizon.name: Okutama and Chichibu ranges (Mount Kumotori)
horizon.note: the long blue ridges of the Okutama and Chichibu mountains closing the Kanto plain to the west-north-west

horizon.name: Shinjuku skyscraper cluster
horizon.note: the Shinjuku towers 6 km to the west-north-west: the twin-towered Metropolitan Government Building, the Park Hyatt trio, the Cocoon Tower, NTT Docomo clock tower to their left at Yoyogi

horizon.name: Shibuya and Roppongi Hills
horizon.note: Shibuya Scramble Square and the Shibuya cluster beyond the Roppongi Hills Mori Tower to the west

horizon.name: Tokyo Skytree (true position, Oshiage)
horizon.note: where the Skytree really stands, north-east across the Sumida; in play it is moved to Harumi (tokyo_layout meta.movedLandmarks), so nothing should be drawn here

horizon.name: Ikebukuro (Sunshine 60)
horizon.note: the lone slab of Sunshine 60 and the Ikebukuro towers to the north-north-west

horizon.name: Boso hills (Mount Nokogiri, Kano-zan)
horizon.note: the low hills of the Boso peninsula across Tokyo Bay to the south-south-east, a faint line over the water with the Aqua-Line and the Kisarazu shore

horizon.name: Mount Tsukuba
horizon.note: the twin-peaked Mount Tsukuba alone on the plain to the north-east

horizon.name: Yokohama (Landmark Tower) and the Miura hills
horizon.note: the Minato Mirai towers of Yokohama down the bay shore to the south-south-west

horizon.name: Haneda Airport
horizon.note: the control tower and runways of Haneda on the bay shore to the south, aircraft climbing out over the port
